exposure: mHealth-CHW intervention (home visit with electronic tablet)
outcome: rate of return to care for patients with a surgical site infection (SSI)
cohort: Patients ≥18 years old undergoing caesarean section at Kirehe District Hospital, Rwanda, excluding non-residents or those remaining in hospital >10 days postoperatively.
finding: The study aims to evaluate the impact of mHealth technology aided by CHWs on the rate of return to care for patients with SSIs.
